title: Farrow Rate Converter
text: Polynomial sample-rate converter with arbitrary conversion factor, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Sample rate of output signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of output signal, {Tolerance for output sample rate} sets the maximum tolerance for output sample rate, {Filter Specification method} sets the method for specifying filter coefficients Polynomial, {Coefficients} sets the filter polynomial coefficients {Polynomial order} sets the order of Lagrange-interpolation-filter, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {View Filter Response}, {View Info}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Fractional Delay} sets the data type of fractional delay fixdt, {Multiplicand} sets the data type of multiplicand fixdt, {Output} sets the data type of output, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value that the block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value that the block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Rate converted signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal in Hz 48e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample rate of output signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of output signal in Hz 96e3 (default) | positive scalar in Hz

params.name: Tolerance for output sample rate
params.values: Maximum tolerance for output sample rate 0 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Filter Specification method
params.values: Method for specifying filter coefficients Polynomial order (default) | Coefficients

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Filter polynomial coefficients [-1 1; 1 0] (default) | real-valued square matrix

params.name: Polynomial order
params.values: Order of Lagrange-interpolation-filter polynomial 3 (default) | positive integer less than or equal to 4

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Fractional Delay
params.values: Data type of fractional delay fixdt(0,8) (default) | fixdt(0,16)

params.name: Multiplicand
params.values: Data type of multiplicand fixdt(1,16,13) (default) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | Inherit: Same as accumulator | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value that the block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value that the block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
